name: Shatadhanus
meaning_en: Name of a son of Hṛdīka.

name: Shatadhanvan

name: Shatasamkhya

name: Shatri
meaning_en: Name of a man (having the. patr. Āgniveśi).

name: Shatrughna

name: Shaushkayani

name: Shavashva

name: Shesha
meaning_en: Name of a celebrated mythological thousand-headed serpent regarded as the emblem of eternity (whence he is also called An-anta, ‘the infinite’; in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa he and the serpents Vāsuki and Takṣaka are described as sons of Kadru, but in one place Śeṣa alone is called king of the Nāgas or snakes inhabiting Pātāla, while elsewhere Vāsuki also is described as king of the Nagas and Takṣaka of the serpents; the thousand headed Śeṣa is sometimes represented as forming the couch and canopy of Viṣṇu whilst sleeping during the intervals of creation, sometimes as supporting the seven Pātālas with the seven regions above them and therefore the entire world ; he is said to have taught astronomy to Garga; according to some legends he became incarnate in Bala-rāma q.v.), ; ; (; 112; 232 n. 1).

name: Sheshanarayana
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Sūkti-ratnākara (a Comm. on the Mahā-bhāṣya; also with -paRqita).

name: Shesharatnakara
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Sāhityaratnākara (a Comm. on the Gīta-govinda).

name: Shibi

name: Shighraga

name: Shighrya

name: Shihlana

name: Shikayata

name: Shiksha
meaning_en: Name of a king of the Gandharvas.

name: Shila

name: Shilalin

name: Shilayupa

name: Shimgi

name: Shimshumara

name: Shineyu

name: Shishumara

name: Shishunabha

name: Shishunaga

name: Shita

name: Shitalasvamin

name: Shitapu

name: Shitikshu

name: Shivabhatta

name: Shivachandra

name: Shivadasasena
meaning_en: Name of the author of the Tattva-candrikā.

name: Shivadatta

name: Shivadayalu

name: Shivavratam

name: Shlishti

name: Shobhana

name: Shraddhada

name: Shraddhadeva

name: Shraddhaha

name: Shrimurti

name: Shrinarendreshvara

name: Shringarasudhakara

name: Shringiputra

name: Shrinkhalatodin

name: Shriram

name: Shrishuka

meaning_en: Name of a king of the Gandharvas.

name: Shuchis

name: Shuchishmat

name: Shuddhaudana

name: Shuddhoda
meaning_en: Name of a son of Śākya, and father of Lāṅgala (Rāhula-Vi.

name: Shudraka

name: Shukla

name: Shuklagulma

name: Shuklodana

name: Shukrita
